description: This file defines a utility class 'JustOneInstance' used to ensure only a single instance of the rusEfi console runs at a time by attempting to connect to a specific port and launching a server socket to listen for additional instances.

classes.name: JustOneInstance
classes.description: Utility class to detect running instances and start a socket server to restrict to a single instance.

methods.name: isAlreadyRunning
methods.description: Checks if an instance of the application is already running by attempting to connect to the predefined port.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts a server socket in a new thread that listens for incoming connections, indicating other instances are starting.
